lesson.text: Quick memory: when does a plant need water? (When its soil feels dry.) Today: the washing, recycling, a pet and the table.
Sort the washing: colours with colours. One red sock in a white wash can turn the whites pink.
Recycling: paper and card, plastic bottles and cans, glass, and food waste each have a bin. Empty and rinse jars and bottles first. Batteries never go in these bins.
A dog needs the right food, fresh water all the time, a daily walk, a clean bed, and a vet when poorly.
Set the table: the plate in the middle, the fork on the left, the knife on the right with its blade towards the plate. Test the smoke alarm once a month.
Try it in the world: open the practice house. Next: labels and the dishwasher, on the Big track.
